title: Obfusku Project Manifest
description: obfusku.toml — the Project marker (spec/adr/ADR-020-obfusku-project-manifest.md). The directory containing this file is the Project root.

format.description: Manifest schema version. Fixed at 1 — the only format this tooling and the obfusku 1.0.0 CLI/LSP support.

entry.description: Bare module name (no '.obk' suffix, no path separators) resolved by a whole-Project-tree filename search, the same way a '⟲' import resolves (ADR-018). "main" matches main.obk wherever it sits under the Project root.

name.description: Optional, informational-only human-readable project identity. Has no resolution semantics in format 1.
